intro: Bible Connections is built on the generous work of others. Here is everything it uses, and on what terms.
intro_es: Bible Connections se construye sobre el generoso trabajo de otros. Aquí está todo lo que usa y con qué condiciones.
intro_pt: O Bible Connections é construído sobre o trabalho generoso de outras pessoas. Aqui está tudo o que ele usa, e em quais condições.

sections.title: Cross references
text: OpenBible.info cross references, based on the Treasury of Scripture Knowledge, under CC BY 4.0 (openbible.info/labs/cross-references). References with fewer than 3 votes are left out.
text_es: Referencias cruzadas de OpenBible.info, basadas en el Treasury of Scripture Knowledge, con licencia CC BY 4.0 (openbible.info/labs/cross-references). Se omiten las que tienen menos de 3 votos.
text_pt: Referências cruzadas do OpenBible.info, baseadas no Treasury of Scripture Knowledge, sob a licença CC BY 4.0 (openbible.info/labs/cross-references). As que têm menos de 3 votos ficam de fora.
text_fr: Les références croisées d’OpenBible.info, fondées sur le Treasury of Scripture Knowledge, sous licence CC BY 4.0 (openbible.info/labs/cross-references). Les références ayant moins de 3 votes sont écartées.
text_ko: Treasury of Scripture Knowledge를 바탕으로 한 OpenBible.info 관주로, CC BY 4.0을 따라요(openbible.info/labs/cross-references). 3표 미만인 관주는 제외했어요.
text_zh: OpenBible.info 串珠经文，以 Treasury of Scripture Knowledge 为基础，采用 CC BY 4.0 授权（openbible.info/labs/cross-references）。少于 3 票的经文连接未被收录。

sections.title: Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek
text: Text, word data and lexicons from STEP Bible (Tyndale House Cambridge), under CC BY 4.0 (stepbible.org). Dictionary entries from Brown-Driver-Briggs and Abbott-Smith, in the public domain.
text_es: Texto, datos de palabras y léxicos de STEP Bible (Tyndale House Cambridge), con licencia CC BY 4.0 (stepbible.org). Entradas de diccionario de Brown-Driver-Briggs y Abbott-Smith, de dominio público.
text_pt: Texto, dados das palavras e léxicos do STEP Bible (Tyndale House Cambridge), sob a licença CC BY 4.0 (stepbible.org). Verbetes de dicionário de Brown-Driver-Briggs e Abbott-Smith, de domínio público.
text_fr: Texte, données des mots et lexiques de STEP Bible (Tyndale House Cambridge), sous licence CC BY 4.0 (stepbible.org). Articles du dictionnaire de Brown-Driver-Briggs et d’Abbott-Smith, dans le domaine public.
text_ko: 본문, 단어 자료, 사전은 STEP Bible(Tyndale House Cambridge)에서 CC BY 4.0으로 제공받았어요(stepbible.org). 사전 항목은 퍼블릭 도메인인 Brown-Driver-Briggs와 Abbott-Smith에서 가져왔어요.
sections.title_zh: 希伯来文、亚兰文和希腊文
text_zh: 文本、词语资料和词典来自 STEP Bible（Tyndale House Cambridge），采用 CC BY 4.0 授权（stepbible.org）。词典条目来自 Brown-Driver-Briggs 和 Abbott-Smith，属公有领域。

sections.title: Places and maps
text: Places from OpenBible.info Bible Geocoding Data, under CC BY 4.0. Coastline from Natural Earth, in the public domain.
text_es: Lugares de OpenBible.info Bible Geocoding Data, con licencia CC BY 4.0. Costas de Natural Earth, de dominio público.

text_zh: 地点资料来自 OpenBible.info Bible Geocoding Data，采用 CC BY 4.0 授权。海岸线来自 Natural Earth，属公有领域。

sections.title_pt: Contagem de versículos e índice de palavras
text: From the Berean Standard Bible (public domain), via scrollmapper/bible_databases (MIT). Only counts and an index are used; no verse text is published.
text_es: De la Berean Standard Bible (dominio público), a través de scrollmapper/bible_databases (MIT). Solo se usan los recuentos y un índice; no se publica texto de versículos.
text_pt: Da Berean Standard Bible (domínio público), por meio do scrollmapper/bible_databases (MIT). Só são usadas contagens e um índice; nenhum texto de versículo é publicado.
sections.title_fr: Nombre de versets et index des mots

text_zh: 来自 Berean Standard Bible（公有领域），经由 scrollmapper/bible_databases（MIT）。只使用节数统计和索引，不发布任何经文文本。

sections.title: Fonts and code from others
text: Atkinson Hyperlegible by the Braille Institute and Bricolage Grotesque by the Bricolage Grotesque Project Authors, both under the SIL Open Font License. QR codes by qrcode-generator (MIT, Kazuhiko Arase); "QR Code" is a trademark of DENSO WAVE.
text_es: Atkinson Hyperlegible del Braille Institute y Bricolage Grotesque de los autores del proyecto Bricolage Grotesque, ambas con la licencia SIL Open Font. Códigos QR con qrcode-generator (MIT, Kazuhiko Arase); "QR Code" es una marca de DENSO WAVE.
text_pt: Atkinson Hyperlegible, do Braille Institute, e Bricolage Grotesque, dos autores do projeto Bricolage Grotesque, ambas sob a SIL Open Font License. Códigos QR com o qrcode-generator (MIT, Kazuhiko Arase); "QR Code" é uma marca da DENSO WAVE.
text_fr: Atkinson Hyperlegible, du Braille Institute, et Bricolage Grotesque, des Bricolage Grotesque Project Authors, toutes deux sous licence SIL Open Font License. Codes QR générés par qrcode-generator (MIT, Kazuhiko Arase) ; « QR Code » est une marque de DENSO WAVE.
text_ko: Braille Institute의 Atkinson Hyperlegible과 Bricolage Grotesque Project Authors의 Bricolage Grotesque는 모두 SIL Open Font License를 따라요. QR 코드는 qrcode-generator(MIT, Kazuhiko Arase)로 만들어요. "QR Code"는 DENSO WAVE의 상표예요.
sections.title_zh: 来自他人的字体和代码
text_zh: Braille Institute 设计的 Atkinson Hyperlegible，以及 Bricolage Grotesque Project Authors 设计的 Bricolage Grotesque，均采用 SIL Open Font License 授权。二维码由 qrcode-generator（MIT，Kazuhiko Arase）生成；“QR Code”是 DENSO WAVE 的商标。

sections.title: Bible.com and translation names
text: Passages open on Bible.com (YouVersion); nothing from Bible.com is copied. Translation names such as NIV and ESV are trademarks of their owners and are used only to label links. This project is not affiliated with Bible.com or any publisher.
text_es: Los pasajes se abren en Bible.com (YouVersion); no se copia nada de Bible.com. Los nombres de traducciones como NVI o RVR1960 son marcas de sus dueños y solo se usan para nombrar enlaces. Este proyecto no está afiliado a Bible.com ni a ninguna editorial.
text_pt: As passagens abrem no Bible.com (YouVersion); nada do Bible.com é copiado. Nomes de traduções como NVI e ARA são marcas dos seus donos e só servem para nomear links. Este projeto não tem vínculo com o Bible.com nem com nenhuma editora.
text_fr: Les passages s’ouvrent sur Bible.com (YouVersion) ; rien n’est copié de Bible.com. Les noms des traductions comme NIV et ESV sont des marques de leurs propriétaires et servent seulement à nommer les liens. Ce projet n’est affilié ni à Bible.com ni à aucun éditeur.
text_ko: 본문은 Bible.com(YouVersion)에서 열리며, Bible.com의 어떤 내용도 복사하지 않아요. NIV, ESV 같은 번역본 이름은 각 소유자의 상표이며 링크 이름으로만 써요. 이 프로젝트는 Bible.com이나 어떤 출판사와도 제휴하지 않았어요.
text_zh: 经文在 Bible.com（YouVersion）上打开；本网站没有复制 Bible.com 的任何内容。NIV、ESV 等译本名称是其所有者的商标，仅用于标注链接。本项目与 Bible.com 或任何出版机构均无关联。

sections.title: Inspiration
text: The arc picture is inspired by the 2007 cross reference visualization by Chris Harrison and Christoph Römhild.
text_es: La imagen de arcos se inspira en la visualización de referencias cruzadas de 2007 de Chris Harrison y Christoph Römhild.
text_pt: A imagem de arcos se inspira na visualização de referências cruzadas de 2007 de Chris Harrison e Christoph Römhild.
text_fr: L’image en arcs s’inspire de la visualisation des références croisées réalisée en 2007 par Chris Harrison et Christoph Römhild.
text_ko: 호 그림은 Chris Harrison과 Christoph Römhild가 2007년에 만든 관주 시각화에서 영감을 받았어요.
text_zh: 弧线图的灵感来自 Chris Harrison 和 Christoph Römhild 于 2007 年创作的串珠经文可视化作品。
